fieldNotes.resolution: Roster coord (41.635358, -91.486512, ROOFTOP) landed on the facility. Confirmed UNFI DC, 2340 Heinz Rd, Iowa City IA 52240 via Yahoo Local, hub.biz, OpenGovUS and the 2003 UNFI IR press release. Legacy-UNFI DC acquired with Blooming Prairie Cooperative (Oct 2002); expanded from ~120,000 to ~260,000 sq ft after 2003.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding/swing gate at any property edge. The DC sits in an industrial park; the truck driveway runs from the park road around the building to the south dock apron with no checkpoint structure. Open-campus archetype.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth identified at the building, the dock-apron mouth, or the access driveway in z18-z20 imagery. A short chain-link fence segment exists near the west office, but no guard booth. Listed uncertain - none visible.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal driveway wraps the building from the park road to the south dock apron; holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: South dock apron plus the trailer drop row gives internal queuing room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~32 dock doors along the single continuous south face from the rhythm of bays and backed-in trailers; moderate ~260k sq ft DC. Exact count uncertain from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A single row of ~20-25 trailers parked nose-out in the drop yard south of the building (`dropYard: true`).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: One continuous dock bank on the south face - not two physically separate ship/rcv banks.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single L-shaped building (main rectangle + a NW section); one facility, not a campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in an Iowa City industrial park (Scott-Six / Heinz Rd area) on the SE edge of town, bordered by woods and a creek - edge-of-town / rural setting per the rubric tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
